name: Yamanobe (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Yamanobe town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Yamanobe, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1972.

features.role: Yamanobe town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a disc
